speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...the mountain's heart burns like Ystra's dying sun...

speaker: Narrator
text: PORT SALTREACH DOCKS. Sunny skies, clear water, and the best fish pies in the Kessler system.

speaker: Narrator
text: NEONIS STARPORT - Deck 7. Mind the landing ring while ships are docking.

speaker: Narrator
text: A holo-ad loops: a glowing jellyfish Alienmon drifts by. 'Stay charged. Stay bright. Neonis.'

speaker: Narrator
text: DIG CAMP - Glyphos Expedition. Keep to the marked paths. Do NOT lick the crystals.

speaker: Narrator
text: Its glyphs pulse softly, like a heartbeat. It feels like it is waiting for someone.

speaker: Narrator
text: The carving shows a ring of stones around a sleeping seed.

speaker: Narrator
text: CINDER HOLLOW. Raised on the first ember seam of Pyros.

speaker: Narrator
text: Below, someone has scratched: 'Dig deep, come home.'

speaker: Narrator
text: The camp furnace. It has not gone out in forty years.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frostmark Research Station. The crystal in this fountain was cut from the glacier and never melts.

speaker: Narrator
text: Founded by survey crews who came for the aurora and stayed for the ice.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frostmark. East: Crystal Caverns.

speaker: Narrator
text: frost grass hides wild Alienmon. Keep a Stasis Pod handy.

speaker: Narrator
text: Aurora Relay Crystal. It pulses in time with the sky.

speaker: Narrator
text: 'Keeper Ingrid Vale awaits challengers on the floor above.'

speaker: Narrator
text: The medical bay's scanner hums. Helix-grade nanites patch up your whole team.

speaker: Narrator
text: HELIX STATION - DOCKING RING. All personnel: report unregistered Linkers to Security.

speaker: Narrator
text: Shift A - cages. Shift B - cages. Shift C - also cages. Complaints to Admin Vex.

speaker: Narrator
text: SPECIMEN TANK 1F-03. Do not tap the glass. It taps back.

speaker: Narrator
text: stabiliser coolant at 81%. Director Thorne wants 100% by next cycle.

speaker: Narrator
text: PROJECT UNITY LOG, Director Thorne:

speaker: Narrator
text: "The Ystran prophecy says whoever reunites all her children lets the Seedmother grow again."

speaker: Narrator
text: "So we will hold all of them. One of every species, in one vault, carried through the Rift."

speaker: Narrator
text: "Whoever holds every species controls her power to regrow life. Then no accident is ever final."

speaker: Narrator
text: the Alienmon inside presses a paw to the glass. The lock reads HELIX ADMIN ONLY.

speaker: Narrator
text: something green shuffles behind the bars. The lock is keyed to an admin card.

speaker: Narrator
text: CONTAINMENT WING 2F. Toxin pools are for Alienmon conditioning. Do not swim.

speaker: Narrator
text: two tanks, two sleeping Alienmon. A sticky note says 'ask Bronn for the code'.

speaker: Narrator
text: status SEDATED. Someone has doodled a sad face on the screen.

speaker: Narrator
text: output 340% of rated. A label underneath says 'it's fine'.

speaker: Narrator
text: Rerouted core power to the Rift engine again. Lights on 2F may flicker. - B.

speaker: Narrator
text: every planet you've visited glows. One dark point beyond them all is marked RIFT.

speaker: Narrator
text: A small crystal shrine. Travellers make a wish here before crossing the Wind Bridges.

speaker: Narrator
text: SKYLINER HALO-1. Boarding by ticket only.

speaker: Narrator
text: THE HOLO-GLOBE. Fourteen worlds turn in its light.

speaker: Narrator
text: lit the night the city tipped into the sinkhole. It has never gone out.

speaker: Narrator
text: 'Thorne knew. The engine does not open a door. It rings a bell, and something below is listening.'

speaker: Narrator
text: A cracked Rift-engine prototype. The orb inside still turns, slowly, toward the floor.

speaker: Narrator
text: A hand-lettered card on the stall: 'Closed until the Helix inspection is over. Again.'

speaker: Narrator
text: Civilian access to the Starfall Rift is suspended by order of the Helix Directive.

speaker: Narrator
text: Teo's tent. The flap is tied shut with a careful knot, as if he meant to come back.

speaker: Narrator
text: A child's drawing is pinned inside: a man, a star, and the word 'DAD'.

speaker: Narrator
text: Teo's Journal, last page: 'The light at the bottom is singing. I think it knows my name.'

speaker: Narrator
text: The campfire is long cold. Three cups still sit around it, one never used.

speaker: Narrator
text: Below, the Rift turns slowly, a purple wound in the crater floor. The hum is louder here.

speaker: Narrator
text: RIFT ENGINE CONSOLE - Containment field: 41%. Output: rising. Authorized by Director K. Thorne.

speaker: Narrator
text: Recovery terminal online. Last full heal before the Great Telescope.

speaker: Narrator
text: CRYSTAL HALL, 1F. Seat of Quorum member Marisol Fenn.

speaker: Narrator
text: Step into the orrery column to ride up to the Sonic Hall.

speaker: Narrator
text: SONIC HALL, 2F. Seat of Quorum member Duke Harrow.

speaker: Narrator
text: The dome hums a low chord. The right staircase climbs to 3F.

speaker: Narrator
text: PLASMA HALL, 3F. Seat of the silent Quorum member Saga.

speaker: Narrator
text: A lone flame burns in the orb. The right staircase climbs to 4F.

speaker: Narrator
text: GRAVITY HALL, 4F. Seat of Quorum member General Ostrander.

speaker: Narrator
text: Beyond this hall, only the Prime Linker waits at the Great Telescope.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every Linker world is pinned here, Dustara to Starfall.

speaker: Narrator
text: One faint point past the Rift has no name, only a note: 'Ystra?'

speaker: Ystran echo
text: I remember this place green. Look, the first moss is back on the Arrival Fragment!

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...welcome home, children of the stars. Rest by the crystal. It still remembers how to heal.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: We were a voice once. Now we are only the echo, waiting for someone to listen.

speaker: Narrator
text: The carved stone hums. A warm light washes over your team.

speaker: Narrator
text: A banner bearing the Seedmother's crest. Stitched below: 'Every road home begins with a single seed.'

speaker: Ystran echo
text: The floating islands are putting down roots again. Terravox hums when it walks.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Terravox carried a forest on its back... these islands were its footsteps.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...do you hear the roots? They are still reaching for each other.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Coral is growing in the Drowned Seas. Aquelion says the dreams are happier.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: These were our seas. Aquelion sang over them... now the water drowns the old roads.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...the coral still grows. Grief is not the same as ending.

speaker: Narrator
text: A drowned archway. Aquelion, Pillar of the Seas, once sang the tides through this gate.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: When the sun began to die, we fed it everything... and still it dimmed.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...go north, into the crystal halls. The light there was ours.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Sun Forge. Ignarch, Pillar of the Sun, fed Ystra's red star from this flame until the very end.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: The Choir chamber sings on its own now. Every note is one of her children.

speaker: Narrator
text: Crystal altar. Glyphs flicker: 'We sang our memory into stone, so the stars would know we were here.'

speaker: Narrator
text: A sealed reliquary. Its light pulses slowly, like something asleep and dreaming.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...this was a library. We sang knowledge into crystal so it would outlive us. It did.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Beyond these halls, the forest sickens. The Devourer's shadow touched it first.

speaker: Narrator
text: A small shrine. A worn carving shows seedpods rising from a great tree into the sky.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Archive Disc. Most of its records are dark. One still glows: a map of stars named Kessler.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: The blight is gone. The little shadows sleep in the new leaves.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...the trees remember being green. If you listen, they will tell you what green sounded like.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Past the void lies the Heartroot's crater. First, you must look into the hungry one.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: The Devourer was never cruel... only hungry, and so very alone.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...if you face it, do not hate it. Hate is a kind of hunger too.

speaker: Narrator
text: A cracked pillar. Scratched in haste: 'It does not hate us. It is only hungry. Do not look into it too long.'

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Every child came home and stayed itself. That is the whole legend. Thank you, Unifier.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: Her world-tree stood here once. Every seedpod that crossed the stars was a piece of her. Now only the Heartroot remains.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...she is tired, Linker. But she waited for you. She always knew someone would come.

speaker: Narrator
text: A crystal shard from the Seedmother's old world-tree. It is warm to the touch, and hums the same note as your partner.

speaker: Narrator
text: A quiet spring shrine. Seedpods once floated here before their long fall between the stars.

speaker: Narrator
text: SEA ARCH COVE. Quiet waters. Something very large sleeps beneath the arch. Please do not wake it.

speaker: Narrator
text: Captain's Log, faded: 'The arch woke again tonight. The water glowed blue all the way to the tower.'

speaker: Narrator
text: The rest of the page is water-stained.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frozen Falls. The water froze mid-plunge, all at once, in a single night.

speaker: Narrator
text: Locals swear a Glaciryx nests behind the ice curtain.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frozen fossil site #1. A jawbone longer than a shuttle, gouged by teeth from something even bigger.

speaker: Narrator
text: The bite marks are ringed with frost that never thaws.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frozen fossil site #2. Ribs snapped clean through. The tooth marks are as wide as a road.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frozen fossil site #3. A thighbone with one huge crescent bite taken out of it.

speaker: Narrator
text: Three sites, one bite pattern. Whatever ate these was the size of a moon.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dig crews say it hums when the aurora is bright.

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...turn the light toward the doors... and only a Chimelet's note can wake them...

speaker: Ystran echo
text: ...you listened... thank you...

speaker: Narrator
text: Liss at the third wind shrine

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib and the 8 shards resonate. The Rift seals! Teo Reyes stumbles out, safe. The Apex Array is now open.

speaker: Narrator
text: You are the new Prime Linker! A path to Ystra has opened.

speaker: Dusty
text: Sola's waiting for you at the trading post. Settle that first!

speaker: Narrator
text: Forge Miner Dax blocks the gate: 'Beat me first!'

speaker: Narrator
text: The harbor gate's runes stay dark. (Needs 2 Signal Shards.)

speaker: Squid Sailor
text: The ferry's grounded till the Relay signal settles. (Needs 4 Signal Shards.)

speaker: Narrator
text: A sealed Ystran door glows red. The Ystran echo whispers: '...learn our story first...'

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Nobody gets in without clearance!

speaker: Narrator
text: The shuttle hatch needs a Helix Keycard.

speaker: Narrator
text: Deep inside, a Relay seal hums. (Needs 7 Signal Shards.)

speaker: Strand
text: Thorne's locked the crater shuttle. Only someone with all 8 Shards could override it.

speaker: Helix Guard
text: This vessel is Helix Directive property. Move along.

speaker: Narrator
text: A rough-looking sailor: Private boat. Shove off.

speaker: Linker
text: Dr. Vashti is calling on your Linker!

speaker: Vashti
text: "Congratulations on your first Signal Shard! I'm sending you my old Hover Board."

speaker: Vashti
text: "Two Shards! You'll be travelling a lot now, so take this Warp Beacon."

speaker: Vashti
text: "Three Shards! Take my Signal Finder. Plenty of Linkers drop things and never find them again."

speaker: Explorer
text: I just saw a Prismatic Alienmon! ...It got away.

speaker: Explorer
text: My partner learned a new move today!

speaker: Explorer
text: Have you tried the Star Arena leagues yet?

speaker: Explorer
text: I'm still training. Call me again soon!

speaker: Explorer
text: You came! Let's see how much we have both grown!

speaker: Explorer
text: You're still way ahead of me... Call me again!

speaker: Explorer
text: Call me any time for another rematch.

speaker: Nurse
text: Leave one Alienmon with us. It earns a little EXP for every step you take.

speaker: Linker
text: Now and then we find an Egg beside it! Walk with an Egg and it hatches.

speaker: Nurse
text: You need at least two Alienmon with you to leave one here.

speaker: Nurse
text: That one is far too powerful for our little Nursery!

speaker: Nurse
text: You can only carry 6 Eggs at a time!

speaker: Linker
text: Oh? Your Egg is moving...

speaker: Linker
text: Who is it? ...Oh, a Linker! Good luck on your journey!

speaker: Linker
text: *A sleepy voice*: Come back later, I'm napping...

speaker: Grandma
text: In my day we caught Alienmon with our bare hands! ...Well, almost.

speaker: Kid
text: Mom says I can get my own Alienmon next year!

speaker: Inventor
text: Don't open the door! My experiment is very, very fragile!

speaker: Collector
text: Did you know some Alienmon only come out at night?

speaker: Chef
text: Something smells good? That's Stardust stew. Secret recipe!

speaker: Linker
text: *Knock knock* Resident: Did you use what I gave you? Good luck!

speaker: Resident
text: Oh! A visitor! Here, take this. I never use it anyway.

speaker: Linker
text: *Knock knock* Resident: That Tech Disc treating you well?

speaker: Resident
text: A Linker! I found this Tech Disc and I don't even have an Alienmon. It's yours!

speaker: Linker
text: Ah, a Linker! Let me rate your Xenodex.

speaker: Linker
text: A fine start! Get out there and catch more!

speaker: Linker
text: Impressive progress! Keep it up!

speaker: Linker
text: Remarkable! Dr. Vashti must be proud.

speaker: Linker
text: Astonishing! Only a few more to go!

speaker: Linker
text: A complete Xenodex! You are a living legend!

speaker: Linker
text: *Knock knock* Resident: My new partner and I are so happy. Thank you again!

speaker: Resident
text: Aww. Come back if you change your mind!

speaker: Explorer
text: Let's see what your team can do!

speaker: Explorer
text: Not bad, Linker.

speaker: Explorer
text: Wow, you two are in sync. Good luck out there!

speaker: Explorer
text: Keep exploring, Linker. Every region has new Alienmon.

speaker: Linker
text: Three empty pod cradles. Your partner's pod used to sit in the middle one.

speaker: Linker
text: Three seed pods hum on the lab table.

speaker: Townswoman
text: Wait! It's dangerous out there without an Alienmon.

speaker: Townswoman
text: Dr. Vashti is waiting at her lab: the big dome with the telescope, across the plaza.

speaker: Narrator
text: You wake up. Sunlight is pouring over the crater rim.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Wonderful. You two already look like you belong together.

speaker: Vashti
text: Your friend Sola was here at dawn and took one of the others. She's already out training.

speaker: Vashti
text: Heal for free at the Recovery Bay, stock up at the shop, and when you're ready, head east over the bridge.

speaker: Vashti
text: The drift grass beyond town hides wild Alienmon. And every world's Keeper guards a Signal Shard. Go see them all!

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Oh dear. That one's shy. It'll turn up.

speaker: Explorer
text: You made it to me! Let's see if you shine like real stardust!

speaker: Explorer
text: Wow... you're the Stardust Champion now!

speaker: Explorer
text: Comets burn bright and fast. Can you keep up?

speaker: Explorer
text: You blazed right past me. The Comet crown is yours.

speaker: Explorer
text: Nobody has outshone me in a hundred battles. Prove me wrong!

speaker: Explorer
text: A brighter star than me... incredible. Supernova Champion!

speaker: Explorer
text: Every light falls into the Singularity eventually. Show me yours.

speaker: Arena Master
text: Welcome to the Star Arena, Linker!

speaker: Linker
text: Four leagues, each with its own level cap. Beat three rounds and the League Champion to take the crown.

speaker: Linker
text: The Singularity League opens once you have won the other three leagues.

speaker: Linker
text: Come back and defend your title any time.

speaker: Explorer
text: Round 1! Let's give the crowd a show!

speaker: Explorer
text: Round 2! You won't get past me so easily!

speaker: Explorer
text: Final round before the Champion! Bring it!

speaker: Explorer
text: What a battle! The crowd loves you!

speaker: Explorer
text: Good luck out there!

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome! Fancy an exhibition match?

speaker: Receptionist
text: Welcome to the Linker Arena!

speaker: Explorer
text: Let's put on a show for the crowd!

speaker: Explorer
text: One on one. No holding back!

speaker: Explorer
text: The crowd came to see a real battle!

speaker: Explorer
text: What a match! The crowd loves you!

speaker: Announcer
text: And the match goes to the challenger!

speaker: Linker
text: Better luck next time, Linker. Your Alienmon has been healed.

speaker: Announcer
text: And that's the end of the run!

speaker: Announcer
text: Three wins! Now for the League Champion!

speaker: Arena Master
text: And for the Grand Champion... Lumivex, the arena's guardian, has chosen you!

speaker: Arena Master
text: You've won all three leagues. The Singularity League is open to you!

speaker: Linker
text: A Rift Breach! Something huge is coming through.

speaker: Vashti
text: "Your antenna needs an upgrade for deeper signals. Sending it now!"

speaker: Linker
text: Mina is calling on your Linker!

speaker: Mina
text: "Splodge found this on the sea floor. It's a Linker antenna! Face any water and dive for a signal."

speaker: Narrator
text: The Three Pillars bow their great heads together.

speaker: Narrator
text: You haven't caught them all. You're sixteen! How can you be the Unifier?

speaker: Liss
text: Nobody said catch.

speaker: Narrator
text: Terravox lowers its forest-heavy head. A floating island above you groans and starts to fall.

speaker: Terravox
text: No one holds up an island alone. Come back with at least three partners beside you.

speaker: Terravox
text: Hold it.

speaker: Narrator
text: A floating island tilts and starts to fall toward the forest below.

speaker: Narrator
text: The island steadies, then rises back into the sky.

speaker: Terravox
text: Strength is not one creature lifting. It is many refusing to let go.

speaker: Narrator
text: Aquelion offers to wash away your saddest memory.

speaker: Narrator
text: The water rises around you... and stops.

speaker: Aquelion
text: If I take it, I take the people who held you through it too. Are you sure?

speaker: Narrator
text: You shake your head. That memory is sad, but it has people you love in it.

speaker: Aquelion
text: You would rather hurt and remember. Then you are ready.

speaker: Narrator
text: The sea goes perfectly still. Aquelion rises, and in its glassy eyes you see the saddest moment of your life.

speaker: Aquelion
text: I keep the dreams of the sleeping. I can take this one away. Forever.

speaker: Ignarch
text: Step into the Forge light alone. No partners.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ignarch waits. The heat does not move.

speaker: Narrator
text: You leave your partners at the edge and walk into the blinding light.

speaker: Narrator
text: It is so hot and so bright that you can't see your own hands.

speaker: Ignarch
text: Courage is going in afraid. Your grandmother did, twenty years ago.

speaker: Narrator
text: Your last partner falls. Oblivane's shadow closes over you...

speaker: Narrator
text: You stop the battle and step forward with Zib.

speaker: Narrator
text: Everybody's somebody's somebody. You think it as hard as you can.

speaker: Narrator
text: You ask Oblivane what it lost.

speaker: Narrator
text: From far away, the Ystran Choir begins to sing. Hmm-mm-mmm.

speaker: Narrator
text: Two hundred years of swallowed light pour back into Ystra's sky as starlight.

speaker: Narrator
text: Oblivane is calm. It drifts away, small and silver, toward the empty crater where the Heartroot glows.

speaker: Narrator
text: Light returns to Ystra's sky... but the land stays bare. The job isn't finished.

speaker: Narrator
text: Starlight falls over your team and heals every one of them.

speaker: Narrator
text: You throw yourself in front of Zib.

speaker: Narrator
text: Orra lowers her hand. The attack fades to nothing.

speaker: Orra
text: That was the test. Could you carry what I carried? You just showed me.

speaker: Narrator
text: You order the attack. Orra's eyes narrow, but she fights on.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every kind of Alienmon in the Kessler system has bonded with you.

speaker: Narrator
text: Under the Seedmother's tree, you walk with every Alienmon you have ever met. They hum the song together, each one still itself.

speaker: Liss
text: The legend called for someone who would reunite all her children. Not catch them. Unite them.

speaker: Narrator
text: You are named the Unifier!

speaker: Linker
text: Your ship needs launch clearance. Win your first Signal Shard.

speaker: Linker
text: Helix Station only accepts its own shuttles. Find a way through the Forge Fortress.

speaker: Linker
text: The Rift's storm tears at your hull. You'll need all 8 Shards to get through.

speaker: Linker
text: Access by Quorum invitation only.

speaker: Linker
text: The coordinates lead nowhere... yet.

speaker: Strand
text: You did it. The crater's quiet.

speaker: Technician
text: The crater pulse finally stopped.

speaker: Teo
text: Home at last. Sola won't stop telling me about you.

speaker: Sola
text: Dad's home. We did it, Linker.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Go find Zib's signal on the bridge!

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Sola's waiting for you at the trading post!

speaker: Marisol Fenn
text: The Quorum waits in four halls. Are you ready?

speaker: Narrator
text: Hank leads you behind the Relay Tower to his hangar and pulls a dusty tarp off something big.

speaker: Explorer
text: Hey! Your Linker just pinged mine. Battle!

speaker: Explorer
text: A new Linker! Let's see what your team can do!

speaker: Explorer
text: You look like you're training. Me too. Battle!

speaker: Explorer
text: My partner's been itching for a battle. You're it!

speaker: Explorer
text: Stop right there, Linker! Show me your best!

speaker: Explorer
text: You'll need to get past us to reach the Keeper!

speaker: Explorer
text: Go on, the Keeper is waiting.

speaker: Explorer
text: Wow, you two are in sync!

speaker: Explorer
text: The Keeper is just ahead.

speaker: Explorer
text: Good battle! Keep training out here.

speaker: Vashti
text: I'm Dr. Vashti. Your Linker can bond with them.

speaker: Linker
text: Choose your first partner, then take the ship and find the rest.

speaker: Linker
text: Your rival Sola took the other starter and blasted off already.

speaker: Linker
text: This is Dustmere, your home town on the crater rim. Head down the path at the bottom of town to step out onto the world map.

speaker: Linker
text: Drift grass hides wild Alienmon. Keepers guard each world's tower and its Signal Shard.

speaker: Linker
text: Your Alienmon are fully healed and cured!

speaker: Shopkeeper
text: Only 3 Singularity Pods per visit. They take ages to charge!

speaker: Shopkeeper
text: Not enough stardust. Win battles to earn more.
